⚡ BoltBeam                                                                (•ᴗ•)
╭──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ Workload                                                                     │
│ Workload is what the Run measures. Decode times one token at a time. Prefill │
│ times the prompt read at once, from 512 tokens up to the model's own cap.    │
│ Session times a 512-token turn appended to a cache already holding 1K, then  │
│ 4 times more, up to the context that fits before compaction. Replay plays a  │
│ recorded session, as token counts, through your own llama-server command and │
│ shows each turn against its roofline.                                        │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ Choose                                                                       │
│ ▸ ● decode   one token at a time, after the prompt                           │
│     prefill  the prompt read at once, at lengths up to the model's cap       │
│     session  a turn appended at depths up to the context that fits           │
│     replay   a recorded session replayed on your server's flags              │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
